1525687.steps:

The SonicWALL SSO Agent Authentication Configuration opens. 2. In the Terminal Services tab of the SonicWALL SSO Agent Authentication Configuration window, click the "Add..." button. View/Edit pane gets displayed in the Terminal Services tab. 3. Type an IP address in the Host Name or IP Address field. Fill in the Shared Key and Confitm Shared Ket fields. Click the Apply button in the SonicWALL SSO Agent Authentication Configuration window. 4. Reopen the configured TS agent, change the shared key with even number of characters with hex format.

  7. Try 17 and 18 length of keys.
